name: Eye Pricing API
Eye Billing API
Eye Books API
Eye Flow Steps
Eye Zoho Webhook
script:
# Zoho Books calls this when an estimate, a sales order, an invoice or a payment changes:
#   https://SITE/api/method/eye.zoho_webhook?secret=WEBHOOK_SECRET
# It only asks for a check; the 5-minute job (Eye Books Every 5 Minutes) reads Zoho and answers.
secret = frappe.get_doc("Eye Books Settings", "Eye Books Settings").get_password("webhook_secret", raise_exception=False)
if not secret or frappe.form_dict.get("secret") != secret:
    frappe.throw(_("Not permitted"), frappe.PermissionError)
frappe.db.set_value("Eye Books Settings", "Eye Books Settings", "check_requested", 1)
frappe.flags.result = "ok"

name: Eye Opportunity Before Validate
script:
# Opportunity · Before Validate: locks requirements Production started on, recalculates the costing and the pricing status.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_before_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Opportunity Before Save
script:
# Opportunity · Before Save: the stage gates. A move to a later stage needs every step of the stages it passes.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing): deal_steps.
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Opportunity After Save
script:
# Opportunity · After Save: a request Production has not started follows the requirements.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request Before Save
script:
# Pricing Request · Before Save: who may change the costs now, cost totals per line.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request After Insert
script:
# Pricing Request · After Insert: assigns the request to Production.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_after_insert", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request After Save
script:
# Pricing Request · After Save: first cost starts the pricing; edits before Sales starts flow to the deal.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request Before Delete
script:
# Pricing Request · Before Delete: only an unstarted request can be deleted.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_on_trash", doc=doc)

name: Eye Quotation Before Save
script:
# Quotation · Before Save: pricing must be done and the net total above the minimum.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="q_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Quotation After Save
script:
# Quotation · After Save: saving a quotation moves the deal to Quotation.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="q_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Billing Request Before Save
script:
# Billing Request · Before Save: the rules are in the "Eye Billing API" Server Script (eye.billing).
frappe.call("eye.billing", op="br_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Billing Request After Save
script:
# Billing Request · After Save: the rules are in the "Eye Billing API" Server Script (eye.billing).
frappe.call("eye.billing", op="br_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Billing Request Before Delete
script:
# Billing Request · Before Delete: the rules are in the "Eye Billing API" Server Script (eye.billing).
frappe.call("eye.billing", op="br_on_trash", doc=doc)

name: Eye Books Every 5 Minutes
script:
# Every 5 minutes: in Zoho mode, reads approvals, invoices and payments when the webhook asked
# (or once an hour), and syncs customers and items once a day. The rules are in eye.books: tick.
frappe.call("eye.books", op="tick")

name: Eye Opportunity Permission
script:
# Opportunity · Permission Query: a salesperson sees their own deals (created, owned or assigned).
# Managers, Accounts, Management, Production and System Managers see every deal.
# (This script runs with its own locals: no helper functions, they couldn't see `user`.)
roles = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"parent": user, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="role")
wide = ["Sales Manager", "System Manager", "Accounts User", "Accounts Manager", "Management", "Production"]
if user != "Administrator" and "Sales User" in roles and not [r for r in roles if r in wide]:
    me = frappe.db.escape(user)
    conditions = ("(`tabOpportunity`.owner = " + me + " or `tabOpportunity`.opportunity_owner = " + me
                  + " or `tabOpportunity`._assign like " + frappe.db.escape("%" + user + "%") + ")")

name: Eye Billing Request Permission
script:
# Billing Request · Permission Query: a salesperson sees the requests of their own deals.
# (This script runs with its own locals: no helper functions, they couldn't see `user`.)
roles = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"parent": user, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="role")
wide = ["Sales Manager", "System Manager", "Accounts User", "Accounts Manager", "Management"]
if user != "Administrator" and "Sales User" in roles and not [r for r in roles if r in wide]:
    me = frappe.db.escape(user)
    conditions = ("`tabBilling Request`.opportunity in (select name from `tabOpportunity` where owner = " + me
                  + " or opportunity_owner = " + me + " or _assign like " + frappe.db.escape("%" + user + "%") + ")")
